summary: Identifies the assigned optical output carrying protection communication to its remote endpoint.
description: Identifies the assigned optical output carrying protection communication to its remote endpoint. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Local protection data” at the input and “Optical transmit path” at the output. Physical link availability does not prove application data validity.
